show.description: When Flight 607 spirals into chaos, air traffic controller Kabeer risks everything to save hundreds of lives, only to be betrayed by his own wife, Nikita, and her lover. Framed, beaten, and left to die, he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with memories intact, Kabeer returns to the same deadly day, this time not just to save lives, but to uncover the truth and take ruthless revenge.
